grh_3a8c718a791cfacb524d.title: Katie Mac Beth
paragraphs: Drifter Toby Hibbert takes work at the McBeth ranch and begins an affair with Katie McBeth while her husband Alex is away. Katie's elderly father-in-law Ramsey discovers the relationship and attacks Toby, but after Toby escapes wounded, Ramsey dies under circumstances Katie later admits were her doing. When Alex returns and confronts the lovers, Toby restrains him while Katie kills him, and they hide his body deep in the wine cellar. Their secret unravels as Toby's guilt grows and another woman exposes what she knows; Toby finally confesses and leads the sheriff to Alex's body. Katie is convicted and sentenced to hang, but after giving premature birth in the prison hospital she dies from internal bleeding before the execution can take place.

[[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes [[person|virginia-gregg|Virginia Gregg]], Steven Markle, Marvin Miller, Peggy Webber, and Howard Culver. Other credited names include Fletcher Markle as director, Fletcher Markle as producer, Brainard Duffield as writer, and Lorne Greene as host.
The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.9b0a0ccffce2f7d3|Sears, Roebuck and Company]].

grh_3a1ed4cb64cedee72c7c.title: The Merry Widow
paragraphs: In Paris, wealthy widow Sonia and Prince Danilo remain in love despite pride, jealousy and Marsovia's fear that Sonia's fortune might leave the country if she marries a foreigner. grh_3a036e285d3ff131a545.title: Assignment Usa
paragraphs: A documentary-style adaptation of Selden Menefee's Assignment USA surveys wartime America after a 15,000-mile reporting trip. The program praises enormous industrial and military effort while also confronting racial discrimination, southern economic grievances, labor-management conflict, housing shortages and other weaknesses that divide the home front. Menefee appears at the end to affirm that Americans are broadly committed to democratic war aims and argues that informed citizens must correct those failures if the country is to win both the war and the peace.

The surviving recording runs about 30 minutes.

grh_3a33f56bd715de3efc3b.title: Leap No More My Lady
paragraphs: Librarian Lucy Plum has spent years waiting on self-centered George Kegley, while the shy but dependable Stan Sherwood quietly cares about her. Dr. Christian and Judy push Lucy to stop arranging her life around George and deliberately let an engagement scheme go far enough to force everyone to show what they really want. When George plans an immediate wedding and a move away, Stan finally protests and admits he cannot bear to lose Lucy. Lucy realizes she no longer loves George, and the manufactured crisis clears the way for her and Stan.

paragraphs: While resting between calls, Dr. Christian is startled by a mysterious woman who brings an urgently ill companion, Moses, into his office.
